text: Fénix is a boy magician in a Mexican circus, son of a knife-throwing father and an aerialist mother who leads [a cult devoted to a raped and armless saint|images|holy and occult objects]. Locked in a trailer, he watches his father [cut off his mother's arms|wrong|killing within the family] and then slit his own throat. Years later he escapes an asylum to perform with Concha in an act where [his arms become her hands|threat|the enemy within], and offstage she orders him to [kill every woman he desires|who_suffers|objects of desire].
